budget: One replay and one previously specified historical-row sensitivity per scheme. No score-based selection or tuning.
evaluation: Use pooled Pearson r squared only to reproduce the photo on the exact same validation keys. Save signed r and all separate section-by-campaign scores; fewer than three rows or zero variance make a profile score undefined. Never pool S1 with S2.

batch_01.H01: Use a documented coordinate map available before cutoff. Same-date peer joint starts are retrospective diagnostics only.
batch_01.H02: Verify raw-to-cleaned parsing and the confirmed scale correction by source row. Evaluate a corrective variant only if a confirmed discrepancy changes input data.
batch_01.H03: Use documented local nominal thickness with construction bounds and dates predating each applicable cutoff.
batch_01.H04: Require confirmed noncomparability. Replay the earlier seam-row exclusion only as a sensitivity: current mentor policy retains eligible seam measurements. Keep holdout labels, keys, and geometry fixed.
batch_01.H05: Use independently verified pre-cutoff S1 ultrasonic measurement as a point-level feature. Own-target ultrasonic data are outside the S2 contract.
